fullPassage: Given the nature of emotional contagion, film is especially well suited to produce it. Carl Plantinga explains this in his discussion of the "scene of empathy," which refers to a scene in which the narrative slows down and a character's emotional experience becomes the focus of attention. Such scenes, which are typically shot in close-up and focus on a character's face, contain several eliciting conditions of emotional contagion. Actors' ability to accurately perceive and express genuine human emotions is also considered crucial in conveying emotional realism. Most important is attention, since contagion responses require that a spectator's attention be fixed on a character's facial expressions. Filmmakers achieve this through the use of extreme close-ups, shallow focus, and various point-of-view structures, and by using progressively closer shots of a character's face and expressions.

questions.passage: Given the nature of emotional contagion, film is especially well suited to produce it. Carl Plantinga explains this in his discussion of the "scene of empathy," which refers to a scene in which the narrative slows down and a character's emotional experience becomes the focus of attention. Such scenes, which are typically shot in close-up and focus on a character's face, contain several eliciting conditions of emotional contagion. Actors' ability to accurately perceive and express genuine human emotions is also considered crucial in conveying emotional realism. Most important is __________, since contagion responses require that a spectator's attention be fixed on a character's facial expressions. Filmmakers achieve this through the use of extreme close-ups, shallow focus, and various point-of-view structures, and by using progressively closer shots of a character's face and expressions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② attention: '가장 중요한 것은 주의'이며, 전염 반응이 관객의 주의 고정을 요구한다고 뒤에서 설명.
❌ ① contagion: '전염'은 전체 주제이지 '가장 중요한 것'의 자리에 부적합.
❌ ③ realism: '사실감'은 바로 앞 문장에서 이미 언급.
❌ ④ empathy: '공감'은 scene of empathy에서 쓰이나 이 문맥과 맞지 않음.
det.tip: attention(주의) — 감정 전염의 가장 중요한 조건. 관객이 얼굴 표정에 주의를 고정해야 전염 발생.
